name: SikaTard-960 HC
paste:
SIKATARD®-960 HC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTard®-960 HC, July 2023, Version 01.06 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikatard_-960_hc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTard®-960 HC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.06).
1.2 Product description. SikaTard®-960 HC is an admixture designed to delay cement hydration. SikaTard®-960 HC facilitates stabilization of concrete mixtures for long periods with no negative effects on final quality.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaTard®-960 HC is recommended for the following applications:
    - shotcrete application
    - when fresh concrete requires stabilization
    - where the temporary prevention of cement hydration of concrete is required
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTard®-960 HC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Cement hydration stabilising admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. SikaTard®-960 HC is a set retarding admixture meeting the requirements of AS1478.1 – 2000 Type Re.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - SikaTard®-960 HC inhibits cement hydration.
    - Does not contain materials promoting steel corrosion.
    - Complements most of the ViscoCrete superplasticizer for a cost-effective shotcrete base mix.
    - With the use of Sigunit® accelerators cement hydration can be re-started on demand.
    - Suitable for mining industry.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: A solution of specially selected surface active organic compounds.
    - Appearance and colour: Green liquid
    - Density: 1.13 g/cm³approximately
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store protected from direct sunlight and frost at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C .

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2023, Version 01.06) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.06) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Depending on the required amount of retardation, 150-1000 mls/100 kg of cement. Please contact our Technical Team for dosage rate out of the above range.
    - Dispensing: SikaTard®-960 HC is added into the mix at the batching plant together with the gauging water.
4.3 Compatibility. SikaTard®-960 HC may be combined with all Plastiment, SikaPlast and ViscoCrete admixtures. SikaTard®-960 HC is also compatible with the most of Sika® Concrete products. Important note: Always conduct field trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika Technical Service for more information and advice.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations. For specific hydration stabilization requirements preliminary laboratory and site trials are essential.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2023, Version 01.06) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTard®-960 HC, July 2023, Version 01.06, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikatard_-960_hc.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaTard®-960 HC, version 08/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sds-sikatard-960hc.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD SikaTard®-960 HC, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/epd-sikatard-960hc.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaTard 960 HC Ready to Perform, version 02/06/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/SikaTard%20960HC%20Ready%20To%20Perform%208pgs%20FIN%20WEB.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
